[spoiler=[b]Trade and Industrial Cooperation Agreement[/b]
[i]Between Luscária and Valddera
Date: May 24th, 2023[/i]]

[b]Preamble[/b]

Recognizing the mutual benefits to be attained from expanded trade, industrial cooperation, and long-term economic partnership, the Paramount State of Luscária and the Malkiate of Valddera, henceforth referred to as the Parties, have agreed as follows:

[b]Title I - General Provisions
[/b]
[i]Section 1.01 - Purpose
[/i]This agreement establishes a framework regarding the bilateral trade of goods, industrial investment, and surplus settlement mechanisms between Luscária and Valddera.

[i]Section 1.02 - Duration
[/i]This agreement shall come into effect upon ratification by both Parties and shall remain in effect for an initial period of ten (10) years, renewable by mutual consent.

[b]Title II - Resource Trade
[/b]
[i]Section 2.01 - Imports (Valddera -> Luscária)
[/i]Luscária shall import the following goods from Valddera at negotiated long-term contract rates.

 Lithium: 20,000 tons ($300 million)
 Iron Ore: 3.4 million tons ($374 million)
 Natural Gas: 3.0 bcm ($750 million)
 Wheat: 520,000 tons ($135 million)
 Onions: 60,000 tons ($13 million)
 Potatoes: 200,000 tons ($50 million)
 Cattle: 120,000 ($150 million)
 Uranium: 250 tons ($45 million)

Estimated Total Value: $1.817 billion annually

[i]Section 2.02 - Exports (Luscária -> Valddera)
[/i]Luscária shall export the following goods to Valddera under the same negotiated rates.

 Copper: 240,000 tons ($2.64 billion)
 Gold: 10 tons ($1.19 billion)
 Crude Oil: 4.0 million barrels ($300 million)
 Chicken: 42 million ($252 million)

Estimated Total Value: $4.382 billion annually

[i]Section 2.03 - Pricing & Delivery
[/i]1. Prices shall be benchmarked against international standards and adjusted biennially by mutual agreement of the Parties.

2. The aforementioned quantities shall be delivered on an annual basis.

[b]Title III - Trade Balance
[/b]
[i]Section 3.01 - Trade Surplus
[/i]The Parties acknowledge that the framework of trade established under this agreement results in an estimated annual surplus of $2.565 billion in favor of Luscária.

[i]Section 3.02 - Surplus Settlement
[/i]The Parties agree that the trade surplus shall be settled through a mix of industrial investment, infrastructure development, strategic cooperation, and financial transfers, as outlined below:

[b]Title IV - Industrial Investment & Surplus Settlement
[/b]
[i]Section 4.01 - OAW Industrial Investment
[/i]1. $830 million of the trade surplus shall be allocated as industrial investment credits to Ostreal Automotive Works (OAW).

2. OAW shall be permitted to acquire land, purchase existing facilities, and establish automotive manufacturing plants, headquarters, and associated R&D facilities within Valddera, subject to Valdderan law.

[i]Section 4.02 - ARVEK Industrial Investment
[/i]1. $720 million of the trade surplus shall be allocated as industrial investment credits to ARVEK, Luscárias national defense and security manufacturer.

2. ARVEK shall be permitted to establish defense-industrial facilities in Valddera, including manufacturing, maintenance, training, and technology cooperation facilities, subject to Valdderan regulations.

[i]Section 4.03 - Infrastructure Offsets
[/i]$580 million of the surplus shall be settled through infrastructure projects in Valddera, including but not limited to transport networks, ports, energy facilities, and logistics infrastructure.

[i]Section 4.04 - Partial Financial Settlement
[/i]$435 million shall be settled through direct financial and currency transfers between the Parties.

[i]Section 4.05 - Total Settlement
[/i]The Parties affirm that the above mechanisms fully settle the $2.565 billion annual trade surplus.

[b]Title V - Final Provisions
[/b]
1. This agreement may be amended through written consent of both Parties.

2. Any disputes caused by this agreement are to be resolved through diplomatic consultation.

3. Both Parties commit to the implementation of this agreement in good faith and in a manner consistent with its objectives.

[b]Signatures
[/b]
[i]Signed on behalf of the Paramount State of Luscária,[/i]
Caudillo Manuel A. Torres

[i]Signed on behalf of the Malkiate of Valddera,[/i]
Malki Osman Rayad
[/spoiler]
